content.text:
The site looks like the approved screenshots again, and both visual tests (desktop and phone) now pass. Three CSS rules in `site/css/styles.css` had drifted from Bootstrap's defaults:

1. **`.img-fluid`**: `max-width` was `150%` instead of `100%`. The hero image overflowed the page sideways on phones.
2. **`.navbar-expand-lg .navbar-nav`**: `flex-direction` was `column` instead of `row`. The nav links stacked vertically on desktop and made the header taller.
3. **`.navbar-dark` `--bs-navbar-active-color`**: it was `#000000` instead of `#fff`. The active "Home" link was black on the dark navbar.

The repo has only one commit, so I found these by comparing the test screenshots against the current rendering, not from a git history. `git status` also lists `.idea` and `.vscode` as untracked. I didn't create them and left them alone.

STATUS: DONE
